user.title: Sign in with Blink
user.description: [Open Blink sign-in]({authorization_url}) in a browser and complete login and MFA. Copy the final URL beginning {callback_url} and paste it below. If the page cannot open, copy its URL from the address bar. Blink Live does not need your password.

verification.title: Verify Blink {kind}
verification.description: Blink sent an additional {kind} verification code. Enter it below.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was rejected, expired, or the callback did not match. Open the new sign-in link and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not complete the Blink request. Check connectivity and try again.
error.invalid_pin: Blink rejected this code. Check the code and try again.

abort.already_configured: This account is already configured in Blink Live.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally configured.

general.title: Recordings and playback
general.description: Choose usb, cloud or all for recording discovery and inferred motion. Automatic downloads are optional. Mount persistent storage and add it to allowlist_external_dirs before configuring the archive directory. Local retention runs with automatic downloads enabled; 0 keeps files indefinitely. Push notifications are not yet supported.

data.motion_timeout: Motion sensor reset delay (seconds after discovery)

rtsp.title: RTSP server
rtsp.description: Disabled by default. Requires a username and password when enabled. Use a reachable HA host address and the chosen port in your player, with RTSP over TCP. Each account needs a different port. Streams are unencrypted; use a trusted network.

http_events.title: HTTP event requests
http_events.description: Send optional HTTP requests for accepted motion and doorbell events. Saving a rule or deleting one also saves the enable setting. No requests are sent by simply editing rules.

http_rule.title: HTTP event rule
http_rule.description: Empty camera selection matches all cameras. URL, header values and body support HA templates. Variables include camera_key, camera_name, entity_id, event_type, event_id, source, occurred_at, observed_at, motion_active and event. Headers must be a JSON object of string values. Requests have a five-second timeout and are not retried.

data.name: Rule name
data.headers: Headers (JSON object; values can be templates)

error.invalid_directory: Choose an existing writable absolute directory allowed by Home Assistant.
error.rtsp_credentials: Enter a username and password. The username cannot contain a colon; credentials cannot contain line breaks.
error.rule_limit: A maximum of 32 HTTP rules is supported.
error.invalid_http_rule: Check the name, URL, template syntax, and headers. Headers must be a JSON object with string values.
